caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of underwear on a plain, light beige background. The underwear is illustrated in a soft greyish-blue tone and is adorned with detailed embroidery. The embroidery features rows of individual, leafy floral patterns that run diagonally across the fabric. There is a vertical strip of decorative lace or embroidery running down the center front, which has small flower-like designs, and the waistband also features a patterned edge. The drawing is signed “Richard Whitaker” in the lower right area. No other objects or elements are visible in the composition.
title: Cutwork Lace Bib
